# source: https://dhakabank.com.bd/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/All-Bank-Routing-Number-26.06.2025.pdf
# checked: 2026-09-05
# endpoints: 329
# The BACH rows that are SETTLEMENT ENDPOINTS, not branches -- TRUNCATION POINT,
# HEAD OFFICE-adjacent RTGS lines, CLEARING HOUSE, AGENT BANKING, REMITTANCE,
# CARD DIVISION. A salary cannot be paid into any of them.
#
# Kept as a separate list from `_bach_routings.txt` so a test can compute the
# table's PAYABLE rows (all minus these) without needing the branch names, which
# that file deliberately does not store.
#
# `HEAD OFFICE` is NOT treated as an endpoint here, matching the rest of the
# directory: some head offices are genuinely payable branches (Sonali's is), so
# deciding by regex would be the guess this whole effort exists to replace.
